record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.context_brief: Distribution of first dynamical degrees in dimension three
record.original_question: For dimension 3, let S_1(3) be the set of first dynamical degrees λ_1(f) arising from automorphisms f of smooth projective threefolds. Is S_1(3) dense in [1, ∞), or is there instead an ε > 0 such that S_1(3) contains no element in the interval (1, 1 + ε]?

evidence.quote: Now, fix the dimension d of the variety, and define the following set of real integers: S1(d) = {λ1(f); f ∈ Aut(X) for X smooth, projective, of dimension d}.
Question 2.9. Is S1(3) dense in [1, +∞[ ? Or, on the contrary, does there exist ε > 0 such that S1(3)∩]1, 1 + ε] is empty ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective complex variety of dimension $d$, and let $f \colon X \to X$ be an automorphism. The first dynamical degree of $f$ is defined by
$$\lambda_1(f) = \lim_{n\to\infty} \bigl( (f^n)^* H \cdot H^{d-1} \bigr)^{1/n},$$
where $H$ is any ample divisor class on $X$ and $(f^n)^*$ denotes the pullback on the Néron–Severi (or cohomology) group; this limit is independent of the choice of $H$ and is an algebraic integer $\geq 1$.

For each dimension $d \geq 1$, define
$$S_1(d) = \{\lambda_1(f) : f \in \operatorname{Aut}(X) \text{ for some smooth projective complex variety } X \text{ of dimension } d\} \subset [1,\infty).$$

Consider the case $d = 3$. Determine which of the following holds:
(a) $S_1(3)$ is dense in $[1, \infty)$; or
(b) there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that $S_1(3) \cap (1, 1+\varepsilon] = \emptyset$ (i.e. the set of values $> 1$ is bounded away from $1$).
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerning the distribution (density vs. gap above 1) of first dynamical degrees of automorphisms of smooth projective threefolds appears in surveys of open problems on automorphism dynamics and is referenced as an open question in recent works on dynamical degrees in dimension 3. No published resolution was found; related results address the surface case or special threefold constructions, but the dichotomy for $S_1(3)$ is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Dynamical degrees, entropy, and Fatou sets (Cantat survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys dynamical degrees and lists open problems concerning the sets S_1(d) of first dynamical degrees realized by automorphisms in dimension d.
status_evidence.claim: The structure of the set of first dynamical degrees in dimension 3 is discussed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of automorphism groups of projective surfaces: classification, examples and outlook
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on dynamical degrees of automorphisms; addresses surface case and outlines open directions in higher dimension.
status_evidence.claim: The higher-dimensional density/gap question for first dynamical degrees remains open.
